create_s3vector_bucket: create an S3 vector bucket with auto-creation if it does not exist
create_vector_index: create a vector index with configurable dimension and distance metric
embed_chunks: embed text chunks using LiteLLM's embedding API with any provider
store_vectors: store text chunks with embeddings and metadata in S3 Vectors
query_vectors: query S3 Vectors index with a text query and return top-k results
